params.body:
Version 4 of the did:webvh log under `/id`: **key-1 moves onto a hardware token.**

key-1 was a file on the MacBook, so a lost laptop meant a lost signing key. Its new key was made on token A (39780281, slot 9E, PIN once and a touch per signature) and replaces the file key in version 4, signed by the next key on token A; the fresh next key is on token B (39780275, slot 9E) with the spare committed beside it. Done with the module and ceremony of #140.

- `did-webvh.mjs verify` holds on version 4; key-1 `x` = `Em18TsOM…LieVbE`, equal to the token key.
- Everything the file key signed before version 4 still verifies through the log history. Whether `/.well-known/did.json` should drop the old key-1 is a separate decision (it would stop did:web verification of what was issued as `did:web:abovebeyond.ai`).
- The trust page says key-1 is now on a token.
- After deploy: write `~/.config/proveml/abovebeyond-key-1.key.json` on the Mac and delete the file key.

The ceremony ran on the MacBook; proposed from the workbench, since the MacBook is no longer a hand.
params.title: Version 4 of the log: key-1 moves onto a hardware token
